hotspots.whyItMatters: UL 365 specifically covers systems connected to a police station — distinct from the central-station model covered by UL 681/NTC material.
hotspots.cite: UL 365 — confirm section in your copy
hotspots.trap: Assuming 'police-connected' and 'monitored by a central station that calls police' are the same arrangement — they're different signal paths with different requirements.

hotspots.whyItMatters: The reliability and backup requirements for the signal path to the police station are the technical heart of this standard.
hotspots.cite: UL 365 — confirm section in your copy
hotspots.trap: Relying on a single transmission path without the required backup/supervision the standard expects for a police-connected system.

hotspots.whyItMatters: Ties the technical install back to the operational (runner/response) side the exam sometimes probes.
hotspots.cite: UL 365 — confirm section in your copy
hotspots.trap: Treating the technical install as 'done' once wired, without accounting for the required response and testing regime the standard also governs.
